name: GetFirstFreeColumnRowFromExcelWorksheet
label: Get First Free Column or Row from Excel Worksheet
description: Retrieves the first free column and/or row from the specified worksheet. Useful for appending new data.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The target Excel worksheet instance to analyze.

fields.name: FirstFreeColumn
fields.label: First Free Column
fields.description: Returns the first free column as a letter (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C').

fields.name: FirstFreeRow
fields.label: First Free Row
fields.description: Returns the first free row as a number.
